name: Research and Development Programme in Water Sector
benefit:
- The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for Basic Research, Applied Research, and Action Research.
- The scheme provides remuneration and emoluments for research personnel assisting the investigators.
- The revised monthly emoluments are ₹25,000/- for a Junior Research Fellow, ₹28,000/- for a Senior Research Fellow, and ₹36,000/- to ₹40,000/- for Research Associates across different levels.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an academician or expert working in Indian Institutes of Technology, recognized universities, recognized engineering and agricultural colleges, or Water and Land Management Institutes. - The applicant must be an expert from an organization under the Ministry Of Water Resources or from a research and development institute or laboratory of the Central or State Government. - The applicant must be from an Indian Non-Governmental Organization registered under the relevant Society Act. - The applicant must be from a non-profit making recognized Indian Private Research and Development Institution registered with the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research. - The applicant must propose a research topic that falls within the subject domain or priority areas related to the respective Indian National Committee. - The applicant must ensure the proposed research has not been done elsewhere to avoid duplication. - The applicant must identify the probable users of the new technology and end-users of the results of the proposed research. - The applicant must not seek funding for foreign travel, salaries of regular employees of the institute, or honorariums for investigators. - The applicant must not utilize the grant for the construction, maintenance, or repair of buildings, or the purchase of vehicles and air conditioners. - The applicant must complete any previous ongoing research projects funded by the Ministry of Water Resources before a new research proposal can be considered. - The applicant must be an Indian citizen to be eligible for research fellowships and associateships. - The applicant must ensure the upper age limit for Junior Research Fellow, Senior Research Fellow, and Research Associate is 28, 32, and 35 years respectively on the day of application. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** The applicant should associate a Co-Principal Investigator in the research scheme. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must execute a bond with two sureties to the President of India if applying as a Non-Governmental Organization. - The applicant must maintain a separate audited account and register for permanent or semi-permanent assets acquired solely out of the project grant. - The applicant must publish research papers emerging out of the research scheme in leading journals with prior approval of the Ministry of Water Resources. - The applicant must acknowledge the assistance received from the funding agency in all publications and patent findings. ##### ***Relaxation*** The applicant should note that the upper age limit for fellowships is relaxable for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Women, and physically handicapped candidates.
